listings.title: Mechanical Solutions Architect Intern
listings.desc:
Mechanical Solutions Architect Intern   
 Astera Labs is a hyper-growth connectivity company building the purpose-built silicon and systems that power rack-scale AI infrastructure. As a Mechanical Solutions Architect Intern on our Solutions Architecture team, you will help ideate and build the mechanical systems around our products, from 3D CAD models to working prototypes that customers see and touch.   
 You will work alongside mechanical, hardware, silicon, and product teams on real deliverables: CAD assemblies, simulations, and demo systems that shape how hyperscalers, OEMs, and ODMs deploy Astera Labs solutions across PCIe, Ethernet, and UALink. Your work will help show how our connectivity accelerates AI and cloud data centers.   
 Responsibilities   
 Mechanical Design & Analysis   
 Develop 3D CAD models of data center components and system-level assemblies   
 Support the design of mechanical solutions such as sheet metal chassis, latches and engagement mechanisms, cable and fiber routing, and electrical connectors   
 Run mechanical simulations and analyses (Ansys preferred) and summarize findings for the team   
 Prototyping & Demonstrations   
 Assist in building component and system prototypes and proofs of concept (POCs)   
 Contribute to demonstrations for customers and industry events that highlight differentiated Astera Labs hardware solutions   
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Architecture   
 Partner with product management, marketing, hardware engineering, and silicon engineering teams   
 Provide system-driven inputs to inform product and technology roadmaps   
 Translate technical results into clear, compelling summaries and presentations for internal and external audiences   
 Basic Qualifications   
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field   
 Foundational experience in 3D solid modeling (SolidWorks, PTC Creo, or similar) through coursework, projects, or prior internships   
 Exposure to mechanical simulation tools (Ansys preferred)   
 Basic understanding of mechanical design fundamentals, such as sheet metal, enclosures, or assemblies   
 Strong written and verbal communication skills   
 Ability to prioritize and manage tasks across multiple stakeholders in a fully in-person environment   
 Preferred Qualifications   
 Coursework or hands-on project experience in data center, server, networking, or semiconductor hardware   
 Familiarity with PCIe, Ethernet, and UALink interconnect standards, and with data center architectures (modules, servers, racks)   
 Experience building prototypes through capstone, research, or student design team projects   
 Interest in product or technical marketing, including white papers, technical blogs, or presentations   
 Internship experience and compensation
 This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.
 Equal opportunity
 Astera Labs is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage anyone with relevant experience to apply.

listings.title: Signal Integrity Solutions Architect Intern
listings.desc:
Signal Integrity Solutions Architect Intern   
 As a Signal Integrity Intern on the Solutions Architecture team, you will model system-level channels across a wide range of compute and switch architectures to determine what is feasible for next-generation AI infrastructure. You will uncover the constraints, bottlenecks, and limitations that shape rack-scale designs, and turn those findings into clear guidance on what is possible.   
 Your analyses will directly influence Astera Labs' product roadmap and feature set, ensuring our connectivity solutions meet system-level signal integrity goals as AI data rates keep climbing. You will work alongside solutions architects, hardware engineers, and silicon teams at a hyper-growth company whose purpose-built connectivity powers the world's leading AI platforms.   
 Responsibilities   
 System Channel Modeling   
 Build and run system-level channel models for a variety of compute and switch architectures   
 Evaluate the feasibility of next-generation architectures across PCIe, Ethernet, and UALink interconnects   
 Identify constraints, bottlenecks, and limitations in end-to-end channel performance   
 Sensitivity and Trade-off Analysis   
 Perform sensitivity analyses to understand interaction effects between channel parameters   
 Determine the main drivers of channel performance and quantify their impact on margin   
 Explore design trade-offs to define what is achievable at the system level   
 Roadmap and Cross-Functional Influence   
 Translate modeling results into system-driven inputs that shape product roadmaps and feature sets   
 Partner with solutions architecture, hardware engineering, and silicon engineering teams to align on signal integrity goals   
 Document findings and present results to technical teams and stakeholders in clear, concise formats   
 Basic Qualifications   
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field   
 Coursework or project experience in signal integrity, transmission lines, electromagnetics, or high-speed digital design   
 Basic understanding of high-speed serial link concepts such as insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk, and equalization   
 Familiarity with the physical layer of high-speed interconnect standards such as PCIe or Ethernet   
 Proficiency with a scripting or analysis tool such as Python or MATLAB for data processing and modeling   
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly   
 Preferred Qualifications   
 Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field   
 Hands-on experience with channel simulation tools (e.g., Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS, or similar) or S-parameter analysis   
 Familiarity with PCIe Gen 6 or Gen 7, high-speed Ethernet, or UALink   
 Experience with statistical or design-of-experiments methods for sensitivity analysis   
 Curiosity and initiative to learn quickly in a fast-paced, collaborative environment   
 Internship experience and compensation
 This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.

listings.title: Business Development Intern
listings.desc:
Business Development Intern   
 Location: San Jose, California  
 Employment type: U.S. internship  
 Team: Business Development, Compute Connectivity Group   
 About the role   
 Astera Labs is a leader in semiconductor-based connectivity solutions that enable the scalability and performance required for modern cloud and AI infrastructure. The Business Development Intern will support the team that identifies market opportunities, develops customer and partner insights, and helps translate business needs into actionable priorities for Astera Labs’ connectivity portfolio.   
 This is a hands-on opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, markets, customers, partners, and go-to-market strategy. You will collaborate with product, engineering, sales, field applications, and marketing partners to research industry developments, evaluate opportunities, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and business audiences.   
 What you’ll do   
 You will help shape the product strategy and commercial evaluation of high-speed scale-up switching silicon that connects thousands of AI accelerators (GPUs/XPUs) into a unified compute fabric.    
 You will work closely with hardware architects, system verification teams, and go-to-market leaders to translate complex distributed AI demands into actionable product requirements.   
 You will conduct market & competitive analysis in the following areas:   
 Interconnect Protocol Benchmarking: Assist in tracking and mapping technical metrics (latency, bisection bandwidth, power dissipation, and die area) across PCIe Gen 6/7, UALink, and ESUN (Ethernet Scale-Up Networks).   
 Use internal LLM-based market intelligence copilots to aggregate, parse, and benchmark PPA (Power, Performance, Area), latency overhead, and cost-per-gigabit metrics.   
 Silicon Cost & Die-Size Tradeoff Modeling: Partner with hardware architects to run AI-assisted parametric models evaluating monolithic switch dies versus chiplet packaging economics.   
 Competitive Intelligence Tracking: Help maintain comprehensive database tracking competitor switch roadmaps, transceiver capabilities, and silicon cost-per-gigabit versus standard and proprietary fabrics.   
 You will conduct customer & workload analysis in the following areas:   
 Distributed AI Workload Profiling: Study communication primitives of large language model (LLM) training (e.g., All-Reduce, All-to-All) to understand how switch tail-latency impacts Model Flops Utilization (MFU).   
 Workload-to-Fabric Translation: Use AI-driven cluster traffic generators and simulation frameworks to model how massive distributed AI training workloads (e.g., Megatron-LM All-Reduce, All-to-All collectives, expert parallelism) strain switch buffer utilization and tail-latency budgets.   
 Cluster Topology Modeling: Build lightweight economic and performance models (using Python/Excel) to evaluate how different scale-up switch topologies (torus, fat-tree, rail-optimized, 1-tier, 1.5-tier, 2-tier) scale across 1,000+ node GPU pods.   
 Automated Telemetry Synthesis: Process raw simulation logs, emulation waveforms, and customer cluster bottleneck logs using internal analytics models to auto-populate and prioritize the next-generation switch feature backlog (PRD updates).   
 Build structured analyses, trackers, dashboards, and presentations that make business and technical information easy to understand and act on.   
 Support opportunity assessments and business cases by organizing relevant data, clarifying assumptions, and highlighting risks, tradeoffs, and next steps.   
 Work cross-functionally with Product & Platform, Engineering, Sales, Field Applications Engineering, Marketing, and ecosystem partners to translate external insights into product, partner, or go-to-market actions.   
 Prepare meeting materials, capture decisions and action items, and help maintain follow-up across internal and external engagements.   
 Communicate technical concepts and their business implications clearly in written updates and presentations.   
 Own a meaningful internship project from scope through delivery and share your findings and recommendations with stakeholders at the end of the internship.   
 What you bring   
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in business, business analytics, marketing, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field.   
 Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize and interpret market, business, and technical information.   
 Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex topics for different audiences.   
 Curiosity about semiconductors, cloud and AI infrastructure, data centers, connectivity technologies, and how technology decisions create business value.   
 Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams, manage details, and follow through on commitments.   
 Comfort working through ambiguity, asking thoughtful questions, and turning open-ended problems into structured next steps.   
 Coursework, projects, or prior experience in market research, competitive analysis, business strategy, product management, partnerships, sales, or technical communications is helpful.   
 Preferred qualifications   
 Familiarity with data center hardware or software ecosystems and technologies such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, ESUN, NVLink, or UALink.   
 Experience creating business analyses, dashboards, presentations, or other structured reporting materials.   
 Experience collaborating with engineering, product, sales, marketing, or external partner teams.   
 What you’ll learn   
 How business development teams evaluate market opportunities, customer needs, partner relationships, and adoption signals in a rapidly evolving technology market.   
 How to connect technical capabilities with customer value, product strategy, and go-to-market priorities.   
 How to communicate research findings and recommendations to technical, business, and leadership audiences.   
 How cross-functional teams work together to bring semiconductor-based connectivity solutions to market.   
 Internship experience and compensation   
 This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.   
 We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

listings.title: Applications Engineering  Intern
listings.desc:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
 Group/Division 
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment. 
 What You'll Do 
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
 We are seeking a highly motivated engineer to join our team in the development, release, and support of KLA’s Film/OCD Metrology products. This role is critical to advancing our technology and solving complex customer challenges through deep technical understanding and innovative problem-solving.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Assist in the development and release of advanced Film/OCD Metrology products.
 Develop a deep understanding of customer applications and use cases.
 Translate customer challenges into actionable problem statements.
 Design and execute data collection plans to support product development and troubleshooting.
 Analyze data and recommend corrective actions or design improvements.
 Communicate effectively through oral presentations, written reports, meeting minutes, and project summaries.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, applications, and customer support teams.
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal.
 Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in semiconductor metrology or related technologies.
 Familiarity with thin film/OCD characterization techniques.

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 
 Who We Are: 
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
 Job Description: 
 This requisition may be classified as on desk or hybrid depending on location and role.
 About the Job 
 HPE Networking is seeking a motivated Business Development Technology Alliances Intern to support business development, partnership development, deal structuring, and contract negotiations with HPE Networking technology alliance partners.
 In this role, you will help advance HPE Networking’s growth strategy by developing partnerships and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Program Management, Manufacturing Operations, Finance, Legal, and Customer Service. You will help align stakeholders on the deliverables and decisions required to successfully execute strategic partnerships.
 You will support partner targeting, business-case development, deal structuring, contract negotiations, and stakeholder management for priority solution areas identified as important to HPE Networking’s growth strategy. This role reports to the Vice President of Business Development responsible for Technology Alliances.
 About the Team
 You will join the Business Development Technology Alliances team within HPE Networking’s Strategy and Business Development organization. The team leads the planning, analysis, and execution of technology alliance and solution programs across HPE Networking’s portfolio, including routing, switching, security, wireless LAN, and software solutions.
 Responsibilities
 In this role, you will collaborate closely with product-line managers, engineering leads, finance partners, legal counsel, and other business functions to support strategic partnerships and deliver business results. Responsibilities may include:
 Partnering with HPE Corporate Strategy, Product Management, and Field Solutions teams to identify and prioritize target solutions and potential partners. 
 Developing strategic assessments for potential partnerships, including their role in long-term build, buy, or partner decisions. 
 Supporting the development of business cases, including financial and P&L impact analyses, for technology alliance opportunities such as OEM, resale, licensing, joint development, and joint venture arrangements. 
 Preparing partnership plans and communicating key recommendations, milestones, and decisions to relevant stakeholders. 
 Coordinating cross-functional teams and tracking milestone deliverables from opportunity assessment through deal completion. 
 Supporting contract negotiations with technology alliance partners, including internal alignment on key business and commercial terms in partnership with HPE Legal. 
 Conducting market, partner, and competitive analysis to inform alliance strategy and investment decisions. 
 Developing financial models, presentations, and executive-ready recommendations. 
 Supporting additional strategic initiatives and analyses related to HPE Networking’s technology partner portfolio. 
 Basic Qualifications 
 Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, business, economics, technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant education and experience. 
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to structure complex problems, collect and analyze data, and develop well-supported recommendations. 
 Experience or demonstrated capability in financial analysis and Excel-based modeling. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 Demonstrated interest in the technology and telecommunications industry, including areas such as campus and branch networking, data center, cloud, security, wireless LAN, or software. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Coursework or experience in finance, business development, strategy, technology partnerships, or a related area. 
 Familiarity with business-case development, P&L analysis, strategic planning, or partnership models. 
 Experience creating executive presentations and communicating recommendations to diverse stakeholders. 
 Interest in networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise technology markets. 
 Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of assigned projects. 
 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

listings.desc:
ABOUT US

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.



The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.



This is a general application used to fill multiple internship openings across our Embedded Platforms teams. If selected, you will be matched to a specific team based on your background and interests during the interview process.

 - Software Engineering Intern - Embedded Systems

 - Software Engineering Intern - Camera Software

 - UIUC Research Park Intern - Embedded Systems Software

 - Vehicle Security Engineering Intern


ROLE SUMMARY

As an Embedded Platforms intern, you will design, implement, and debug core software running on ECUs and embedded Linux or RTOS environments, and contribute directly to the software used for verification and board bring up on next generation vehicle platforms.

Specific project areas vary by team and may include:

 - Bringing up new ECUs and development boards, including drivers, bootloaders, and board support software

 - Implementing and optimizing Hardware Abstraction Layers (HALs) that connect vehicle software to hardware

 - Working on embedded Linux or Android platform components running on vehicle electronics

 - Developing and benchmarking real time operating system kernel features, with a focus on reliability and performance

 - Building security firmware features such as secure boot or cryptographic services on vehicle ECUs

 - Developing camera and imaging software on embedded hardware

 - Writing automated tests and CI integrations that validate platform software on real hardware


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop, and deploy embedded software on Linux, Android, or real time operating systems for electronic hardware

 - Contribute to the implementation and optimization of HALs for vehicle hardware interaction

 - Debug and troubleshoot issues at the firmware, driver, and board level

 - Work closely with cross functional teams, including hardware, charging, and body controls engineers, on software initiatives

 - Document your work and present progress to your team throughout the internship


QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum:

 - Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program at an accredited US university

 - Proficiency in C or C++

Preferred:

 - Actively pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field, with intent to return to school after the internship

 - Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Shell, or Go

 - Coursework or project experience in embedded software development

 - Understanding of real time operating system fundamentals

 - Familiarity with embedded Linux environments

 - Familiarity with kernel level development or automotive communication protocols

 - Experience with interface protocols such as CAN, Ethernet, SPI, or I2C

 - Interest in automotive systems and applications

listings.title: CST Application Engineer Intern - Silicon
listings.desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 
 Are you currently enrolled in a STEM, electrical engineering, or computer engineering program and seeking an exciting summer 2027 internship with a leading Silicon Valley technology company? Join the Cadence Design Systems Customer Success Team (CST), where you will work with industry-leading electronic design automation (EDA) tools and collaborate with technical experts in a dynamic, innovative environment focused on silicon design, systems development, and design automation. You will gain insight into leading-edge silicon and systems technologies, learn how a global technology company operates, and experience how technical teams solve complex engineering challenges. 
 Cadence is a global leader in electronic design, building on more than 35 years of computational software expertise. Through its Intelligent System Design strategy, Cadence delivers software, hardware, and intellectual property that transform silicon and electronic design concepts into reality. 
 Cadence serves many of the world’s most innovative companies, enabling extraordinary electronic products—from chips and boards to complete systems—for dynamic markets including consumer electronics, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace, industrial, and healthcare. 
 At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who are committed to advancing technology and making a meaningful global impact. 
 Where is the internship located? 
San Jose, California
 What does the internship offer? 
Interns will participate in a three-month, cohort-based program alongside peers from across the United States. The program provides hands-on training in applications supporting system and package design; digital and analog IC design and simulation; physical design and analog layout; advanced verification; hardware emulation; and the application of artificial intelligence across these disciplines. Interns will also learn from technical experts and application engineers who provide design services, technical sales support, and customer support to Cadence’s most advanced customers. 
 The cohort-based program provides experience in the following areas: 
 Fundamentals of design, verification, synthesis, and timing analysis 
 Embedded software development and hardware/software co-design and co-verification 
 UNIX, C/C++, and scripting languages such as Perl, Tcl, and Python 
 Digital physical design and implementation for silicon and systems 
 Analog physical design and implementation for silicon 
 Signoff analysis for timing, IR drop, power, and signal integrity 
 Application of artificial intelligence to enhance design flows and methodologies 
 How long is the internship? 
The internship is a three-month program scheduled for summer 2027. 
 Position Requirements: 
 The ideal candidate is a rising senior pursuing a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or another STEM discipline at an accredited university. Experience with electronic design automation (EDA), foundational silicon, package or board design, or AI use cases is preferred. Candidates must be able to manage multiple complex assignments and demonstrate strong communication, presentation, assessment, and analytical skills.
 We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

listings.title: Electrical Validation Engineer Intern
listings.desc:
Electrical Validation Engineer Intern
 Astera Labs · San Jose, CA · Internship · On-site 
 About Astera Labs
 Astera Labs builds connectivity solutions that help power modern AI infrastructure. Our Electrical Validation teams measure, debug, and validate the electrical behavior of complex hardware platforms so products can move confidently through bring-up, validation, and release.
 The opportunity
 Join the Electrical Validation team and gain hands-on experience validating high-performance hardware. You’ll learn the team’s products, lab environment, measurement methods, firmware and update flows, and validation processes while contributing to a scoped project with a visible technical outcome.
 This internship is designed for someone who enjoys working close to the hardware: setting up an experiment, selecting the right instrument, collecting trustworthy data, analyzing the result, investigating unexpected behavior, and documenting what the team should do next. You’ll collaborate with Electrical Validation, firmware, system validation, ATE, PApps, program-management, and other engineering teams.
 What you’ll do
 Learn the Electrical Validation environment, assigned product area, lab equipment, scripts, specifications, and project success criteria.
 Run repeatable electrical measurements and validation workflows for hardware platforms, boards, links, interfaces, or subsystems.
 Set up and use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, BERTs, VNAs, power supplies, electronic loads, temperature chambers, probes, and related fixtures under engineering guidance.
 Collect, organize, and analyze voltage, current, timing, signal-quality, link, power, temperature, or other electrical data as appropriate for the project.
 Compare results with specifications, expected behavior, previous runs, and validation criteria; identify trends, anomalies, margins, and failure conditions.
 Support hardware bring-up and debug by checking connections, configurations, firmware or update flows, test scripts, instrument settings, and environmental conditions.
 Develop or improve Python, shell, or other automation scripts for measurements, data collection, report generation, or repeatability.
 Create clear data packages, validation reports, plots, checklists, Confluence pages, and handoff documentation that others can trust and reuse.
 Investigate defined technical issues, form evidence-based hypotheses, run focused experiments, and communicate recommended next steps.
 Collaborate with firmware, system validation, ATE, PApps, design, and other cross-functional teams to unblock shared execution and close assigned tasks.
 Keep project trackers, action items, and technical documentation current while communicating progress, blockers, and risks.
 Own a scoped validation workflow or product slice with increasing independence and present your project, results, and key learnings at the end of the internship.
 What you bring
 Coursework, projects, research, or hands-on experience in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or a related field.
 Foundational understanding of circuits, electronics, digital systems, signal integrity, power, measurements, or hardware interfaces.
 Interest in learning how to use laboratory instruments and how to turn measurements into reliable engineering conclusions.
 Programming or scripting experience in Python, C/C++, MATLAB, shell, or another language used for automation and data analysis.
 Comfort learning in a Linux or technical lab environment and working with specifications, logs, plots, test procedures, and source control.
 A methodical approach to troubleshooting: verify the setup, isolate variables, collect evidence, compare against expectations, and document what changed.
 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain results and uncertainty to cross-functional partners.
 Ownership, curiosity, humility, and persistence in an environment where experiments may need to be repeated and refined.
 Helpful experience
 Oscilloscopes, BERTs, VNAs, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, or temperature chambers.
 High-speed serial links, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, SERDES, clocking, jitter, eye diagrams, or signal-quality measurements.
 Board bring-up, firmware update flows, test fixtures, lab automation, or hardware debugging.
 Python data analysis, instrument control, report generation, or automated regression.
 Validation plans, test coverage, failure triage, data packages, or technical report writing.
 Jira, Confluence, Excel, Git, or other collaborative engineering workflows.
 Internship experience and compensation
 This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.
 Equal opportunity
 Astera Labs is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We value diverse perspectives and consider qualified candidates without regard to legally protected characteristics.

listings.title: Software Engineering Intern
listings.desc:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
 Group/Division 
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.  Software Engineering Intern: On-Demand Containerized Test Environments 
 Our team builds the distributed software behind high-end semiconductor inspection systems. Testing that software at the system level often needs real hardware or large, dedicated test environments, which are expensive and slow to set up. This summer you'll help change that.
 The project You'll build containerized test harnesses that emulate multi-node distributed systems on a single server. The harnesses start when a test run needs them and shut down when it's done. You'll:
 Extend an existing container-based prototype into a configurable, multi-service test environment.
 Add network delay and fault injection to simulate different system configurations and failure modes.
 Validate the harness by reproducing real past defects.
 Integrate it into our CI pipeline so integration tests run automatically on code changes.
 If time allows, apply the same framework to a second, larger distributed system (a central server plus about 20 nodes), replacing a dedicated VM test environment and measuring the resource and startup-time savings.
 What you'll learn How large distributed systems are built and tested in production, along with practical experience in containers, test automation, and CI. Your work will make a measurable difference in developer productivity and infrastructure cost.

 Basic networking concepts

 Docker or other container tools
 CI/CD pipelines
 Distributed systems coursework or experience

listings.desc:
Change the world. Love your job. 
 Do you strive to understand how electronics work, and enjoy debugging, coding and/or solving technical problems? Here's your chance to innovate for the future! Applications Engineer Interns at Texas Instruments (TI) are technical experts who are focused on leading-edge digital, mixed signal and analog products. We have a strong customer commitment and a great team spirit. If you are looking for an interesting and challenging position with a wide range of exciting responsibilities, you've come to the right place.
 In this position, you'll work directly with TI customers to determine their major design challenges and partner with them on creating solutions that focus on ease-of-use and add value to their solution. You may also spend hands-on time in a TI lab tackling problems and delivering innovative development solutions that support our products and drive revenue.

 Working with design, marketing, sales, and product definition teams to successfully launch new products into the market
 Promoting TI products and providing appropriate technical solutions to customers to solve their design challenges

 Supporting the customer's technical seminars and distributor training sessions
 Put your talent to work with us as an Applications Engineer Intern !

 Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher

 Knowledge and understanding of analog circuitry (examples include: op-amps, DC/DC power, data converters, sensing, etc.)
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, along with soldering and debugging skills

 Demonstrated strong analytical and problem solving skills
 Excellent communication and presentation skills
 Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
 Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment
 Ability to take initiative and drive for results

listings.title: Intern - Service Product Marketing
listings.desc:
ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY 
 Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. 
 WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY? 
 Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together. 
 POSITION SUMMARY:          
 Advanced Energy is currently seeking a Product Marketing Intern to support the Global Service Product Marketing and Management Team in the execution of product lifecycle, reporting, and data analysis tasks. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Manage discontinuance and obsolescence process for multiple product lines. 
 Complete data analyses for component obsolescence, end of life considerations, and product lifecycle reporting. 
 Regular reporting of operations, production, or product lifecycle data in Excel, PowerPoint, or Power BI format. 
 Support marketing releases for Global Service products, including collateral releases, email promotions, and trade show support. 
 Support new product intake, product marketing, and set up of new part numbers. 
 Support SAP data cleansing activities for move to next gen ERP system. 
 Regular support of online customer portal activities, including identifying Global Service marketing opportunities and improving customer experience. 
 WORK ENVIRONMENT: 
 Location: Fort Collins, CO 
 Environment: Standard Office Environment. 
 QUALIFICATIONS : 
 Excellent PC skills including Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams), Smartsheet, SharePoint, and enterprise software. 
 Ability to collaborate and involve others in decision-making and problem solving. 
 Ability to present ideas in a clear and persuasive manner, both orally and in writing. 
 Ability to motivate others in a team environment. 
 Strong organizational skills. 
 EXPERIENCE: 
 Previous experience working on multiple projects is desired. 
 EDUCATION: 
 Currently enrolled in a university or community college. 
 Working towards an Associates or BS in Business Administration, Project Management, Marketing, or closely related field preferred. 
 COMPENSATION:                            
 As required by multiple state pay transparency laws, Advanced Energy provides a reasonable range of compensation for each job posting.  Actual compensation is influenced by an array of factors including, but not limited to, skill set, level of experience, and specific office location. The range of starting pay for this role is $20 to $25 per hour.    
 BENEFITS: 
 As part of our total rewards philosophy, we believe in offering and maintaining competitive compensation and benefits programs for our employees to attract and retain a talented, highly engaged workforce. Our compensation programs are focused on equitable, fair pay practices including market-based base pay, an annual pay-for-performance incentive plan, and discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan.  
 In addition to our competitive compensation practices, we offer a strong benefits package in each of the countries in which we operate. In the U.S., we offer a rich benefits package to all full-time regular employees that includes: 
 Medical - multiple medical plans are available to choose from 
 Short and long-term disability and life insurance 
 Health savings and flexible spending accounts 
 Generous time off policy starting with 3 weeks of paid vacation, 7 days of paid sick time, and 12 paid holidays 
 8 hours of paid volunteer time off 
 8 weeks of paid parental leave for both parents 
 Company matched 401(k) 
 Tuition reimbursement 
 Expanded mental health coverage and employee assistance programs   
 Other voluntary benefits include critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity, pet insurance, identity theft, and legal assistance 
 Advanced Energy is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.  
 Advanced Energy is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our job application process/procedures for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance in completing an Advanced Energy application, please reach out to HumanResources@aei.com. 
 CO ONLY: 
 Applications will be accepted through 11/30/2026, the company reserves the right to review applications at any point after they are submitted. 
 Nearest Major Market: Fort Collins
 Nearest Secondary Market: Loveland

listings.desc:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.
 Applications accepted until further notice 
 Meet the Team   
 The Cisco Product Organization is the engine behind the platforms, technologies, and solutions defining the next generation of connectivity. Spanning AI Software & Platforms, Core Product Engineering, Collaboration, Security, Networking, Silicon, and Observability, we build the critical infrastructure that powers the digital world. Millions of people rely on our platforms every day, and our teams work together to build, refine, and scale products that drive meaningful impact. We are a team of passionate innovators, united by our curiosity, collaboration, and dedication to helping one another do our best work. Ready to help us build what's next?  
 The Cisco Product Internship Program offers a 12-week summer experience designed to welcome early-career talent into this mission. We embed interns within high-impact teams, where they collaborate directly on the products, platforms, and architectures shaping Cisco's future and powering the AI era. Throughout the program, interns have the opportunity to participate in targeted learning sessions, multi-functional networking, and direct engagement with leaders across the organization. By immersing interns in real-world challenges, we help them build the technical skills, confidence, and collaborative approach needed to envision a long-term, impactful career at Cisco.  
 Your Impact   
 You'll solve real problems from day one by designing, building, and shipping the APIs and applications that power our platforms. You'll write clean, maintainable back-end code, designing RESTful services and distributed architectures alongside your team, with opportunities to contribute to front-end systems as projects demand. When challenges arise, you'll troubleshoot together to sharpen your engineering instincts. By developing and maintaining scalable software, you enable our business groups to leverage reliable services, ensuring we deliver high-impact technology solutions that connect the world. 
 Minimum Qualifications    
 Currently enrolled in one of the following: 
 - An undergraduate degree program (Associate's or Bachelor's) with 2 years of work experience ; or  
 - A Master’s degree program with 0 years of work experience . 
 -Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.   
 -Expected to continue enrollment in degree program following completion of the internship. 
 Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Go 
 Experience building or supporting software applications or services, including APIs 
 Familiarity with core software engineering workflows, tools, and development environments such as Git and Linux 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Proficiency in two or more of: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, or React, with UI/UX principles awareness 
 Experience applying Object-Oriented Programming principles, with exposure to C/C++ or JavaScript 
 Hands-on experience with RESTful services, distributed systems, or microservices 
 Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or deployment or automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes) 
 Exposure to networking fundamentals (L2/L3, TCP/IP), cloud security, or DevOps/DevSecOps practices 
 #productintern27    
 Why Cisco? 
 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. OEM Solutions Sales Undergraduate Intern 
 Do you want to join a fast-paced team driving innovation inside of Dell Technologies? Do you have a passion for creativity and innovative ideas to help customers satisfy their business needs with unique technology solutions? Our OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer)   Solutions organization has a Summer Internship available for someone wishing to explore sales and marketing career paths while fueling their personal & professional goals.
 Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an OEM Solutions Sales Undergraduate Intern on our OEM Solutions team in Round Rock, Texas .
 What you’ll achieve: 
 As an OEM Solutions Sales Undergraduate Intern , you will develop and apply workplace knowledge, building toward a specification in sales and marketing. Key focus areas will include sales lead distribution between partners and sales operations as well as establishing a tracking process through available sales tools. You will learn how OEM Solutions partners with customers and resellers to innovate and deliver unique hardware, software and services solutions. Learn more about our team here .
 You Will: 
 Partner with support organizations to learn operations and sales tools including Salesforce.com
 Engage with sales managers and team members to learn selling motions and best practices
 Develop organizational behavior skills and establish corporate workplace ethics
 Cultivate effective communication skills and executive presence

 Knowledge of Microsoft Office products
 Strong assessment, judgement and organizational skills
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
 Presentation skills
 Pursuing an Undergraduate Degree in Sales or a related field with an expected graduation date of December 2027  or May 2028 and ability to join the internship program on June 1, 2027

 Marketing or sales experience
 Able to manage time and prioritize effectively; demonstrates an ability to cope with a complex and changing environment
 Compensation

 Who we are 
 We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

listings.title: Internship Program: Technical Sales
listings.desc:
What you’ll do:
 We make what matters work.   
You want to make an impact in the world. At Eaton, we’re solving some of the toughest challenges on the planet. Our Early Talent Programs open up an exciting world of opportunities for you to make a difference on a global scale. As part of these programs, you'll dive headfirst into real-world problems, honing the skills you need to develop into a top-tier leader. Your assignments are more than tasks and busy work, they're your chance to drive innovation in intelligent power management and shape the future of our company. And now for the best part - you won't be on a solo mission. You'll team up with seasoned leaders, gaining diverse experiences that'll drive you forward to reach your career goals.   
 What sets our Early Talent Programs apart:    
 Personalized Program Experience: We’re committed to energizing your career and empowering your impact. No two participants share the same experience or set of responsibilities.
 Role Exploration: In our programs, you'll explore various roles early on. This allows you to build your skills and maximize your potential for future roles.
 Strategic Networking: Collaborate with senior leaders with mentorship programs woven into your experience. 
 Global Perspectives: Our Development Program spans diverse businesses and locations. Relocating to an endorsed Eaton site is a required part of the adventure, enhancing your learning and maximizing program benefits.
 It’s time to make connections, get energized, and power ahead.   
 Eaton provides a competitive total rewards package commensurate with applicable skills, knowledge, and experience and consistent with internal and external market practices. The salary for this role ranges from $20.77 - $25.96 per hour. 
 Position Overview:      
 Over the course of this 12-week paid internship, interns will engage in projects that hold tangible significance for our business while receiving guidance and mentorship from Eaton's esteemed leaders. The Technical Sales Internship Program provides challenging sales assignments that will build the participant’s sales, technical and leadership skills while growing product and functional knowledge base. The program provides personal development and the opportunity to grow leadership attributes through training, networking and coaching. The assignment could be located at a sales office anywhere in the US. Relocation will be provided and geographic flexibility is required.    
 This program provides great exposure to Eaton and prepares participants to be considered for the Eaton Technical Sales Development Programs upon graduation.    
 Qualifications:
 Required (Basic) Qualifications:   
 Must be actively enrolled in a bachelor's degree program from an accredited institution
 Minimum overall cumulative GPA of 2.8 
 Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.
 Must be geographically flexible to relocate within the United States
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 Overall cumulative GPA of 3.2 or higher
 Prior internship or co-op experience
 Demonstrated leadership experience within campus and/or community
 Enrolled in an engineering or business degree from an accredited institution 
 Ability to speak a second language
 Completion of sophomore year by the start of internship
 Skills:
 Position Criteria:   
 This role may include travel (up to 25%) within a local region as determined by the Technical Sales Assignment Manager
 This role may require the employee to maintain a valid and unrestricted driver’s license
 Transportation to and from the worksite and for incidental business travel is the responsibility of the intern; however, expenses for required and approved business travel (not including the worksite) will be reimbursed
 The summer internship culminates with a formal presentation where interns showcase their success stories to leaders of the organization and receive feedback on their performance

listings.title: AI Software Intern (Summer 2027)
listings.desc:
About GlobalFoundries   
 GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, powerefficient and highperformance solutions for highgrowth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.  
 Internship Program Overview:    
 Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives.  
 Summary of Role:   
 GlobalFoundries is seeking a curious and driven AI Software Intern to help bridge cutting-edge machine learning research and scalable software production. Working alongside senior software engineers, the intern will build, optimize, test, and deploy AI models within an AI platform while gaining hands-on exposure to the AI inference software lifecycle and AI processor architectures.  
 Essential Responsibilities include:   
 Assist with integrating, deploying, testing, and scaling machine learning models, including large language, computer vision, and predictive models, within production-oriented AI pipelines.   
 Analyze latency, memory usage, and computational footprint, and help optimize AI inference workflows for edge devices or cloud infrastructure.   
 Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software prototyping, code development, testing, and debugging while following team engineering and review practices.   
 Document engineering designs, experiment configurations, performance benchmarks, software interfaces, and API architectures so work is clear, reproducible, and maintainable.  
 Other Responsibilities:   
 Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
 Required Qualifications:   
 Education – At least a sophomore at time of application and actively pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship.   
 Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and be in good academic standing.   
 Familiarity with at least one major machine learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.   
 Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and software version control using GitLab, GitHub, or related tools.   
 Ability to navigate ambiguous technical problems, learn new tools quickly, and communicate technical trade-offs effectively.   
 Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)   
 Ability to work at least 40 hours per week during the internship.  
 Preferred Qualifications:    
 Prior related internship or co-op experience   
 Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc.   
 Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making.   
 Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.   
 Strong written and verbal communication skills   
 Strong planning & organizational skills   
 Familiarity with low-level, high-performance programming, such as kernel optimization, systems programming, or hardware accelerators.   
 Exposure to cloud systems such as AWS, and participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source projects, or university research labs.  
 #InternshipProgramUS

 Familiarity with SPICE, Verilog, formal verification, or electronic design automation tools.

 Interest in AI-assisted engineering methods, performance modeling, post-silicon analysis, or silicon debug.

listings.title: Engineering Intern
listings.desc:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
 Group/Division 
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high-volume manufacturing. 
 What You'll Do 
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
 VUV Detector Characterization and Analysis Intern
 Job duties will include supporting research and development of advanced detector characterization methods for next generation semiconductor inspection technologies. Opportunities exist for experimental testing of optical detectors, development and execution of measurement workflows, data acquisition and analysis, and improvement of characterization methodologies and test efficiency. The intern will evaluate key detector performance parameters including photon transfer characteristics, quantum efficiency, and quantum yield in the vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) spectral region.
 Desired Qualifications:
 • Pursuing a degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Optical Engineering, or a related field.
 • Fundamental knowledge of optics, cameras, image sensors, or detector characterization principles.
 • Experience with experimental data collection, analysis, and visualization using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or similar tools.
 • Hands-on experience with laboratory instrumentation, optical measurements, detector handling, or related experimental techniques.
 • Familiarity with scientific data analysis, statistical methods, and measurement uncertainty evaluation.
 • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical findings through reports and presentations.
 • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a diverse team of scientists and engineers.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Requires less than 1 year of related experience
 About KLA 
 We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us?  Ramping up on storage-related technical knowledge/concepts: ARM, AXI, PCIe, NVMe, DDR, NAND Flash, DMA, encryption, and so on. 
 Learning through practice of verification methodologies. 
 Working under guidance of the technical lead. 
 Working in the SOC verification environment to debug and root-cause failures in SOC. 
 Writing Embedded C programming code and run testcases. 
 Verification environment using UVM testbench. 
 Run and develop Python/TCL/Shell verification scripts to test the SOC verification.

 Actively pursuing a BS degree in Electrical Engineering, MS degree preferred 
 Courses in digital design, computer architecture and C programming is a must 
 Proficient in Verilog/SystemVerilog, C programming, TCL/Python/Shell Scripting 
 Excellent analytical, programming, debugging and scripting skills 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 Ability to work independently and in a team environment 
 Experience with simulation, UVM and simulation tools a plus

listings.title: Software Engineer Intern (C++, Linux) – Summer 2027
listings.desc:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
 Group/Division 
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production. 
 What You'll Do 
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
 Are you excited about solving real-world engineering challenges and learning from experienced professionals? We’re looking for a curious and motivated Software Engineering Intern to join our team for Summer 2027.
 In this role, you’ll get hands-on experience working with machine control and inspection software used in advanced mask inspection systems.
 You’ll collaborate with engineers across disciplines — including electrical, mechanical, optical, algorithm, and software — to explore system-level solutions and contribute to meaningful projects.
 This is a great opportunity to grow your skills in a supportive environment while working on impactful technology.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 • Must be in penultimate year of study, with graduation expected in 2028.
 • Experience building apps in the C++ programming language.
 • Exposure to scripting languages like Python or JavaScript.
 • Interest in software design, data structures, and algorithms.
 • Some experience or coursework involving multi-threaded or multi-process programming.
 • Willingness to learn, collaborate, and contribute to team success.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 • Graduation date and programming experience listed on resume.
 • Familiarity with C++ programming.
 • Basic understanding of Linux or experience using it in coursework or projects.
 About KLA 
 We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
 Total Rewards 
Base Pay Range: $37.00 - $49.00 per hour based on pursuit of a Bachelors and Masters
Primary Location: USA-CA-Milpitas-KLA 
 KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

listings.title: Enterprise Platform Technical Marketing Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
listings.desc:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 As an Enterprise Platform TME intern, you will help accelerate adoption of NVIDIA Enterprise solutions by building the workflows, demos, and technical content that show partners and customers what GPU-accelerated platforms make possible. You will stand up AI and agentic AI workflows end to end and then explain them clearly to engineering audiences and at public events, developing the technical marketing assets that bring them to life — product and technology demonstrations, videos, playbooks, and targeted content. A core part of the role is translating Enterprise Platform capabilities into real-world use cases across Manufacturing, AECO, and Media & Entertainment. Working closely with key OEM partners and internal teams, you will help define the demos that showcase GPU-enabled enterprise platforms, produce the technical collateral that supports them, and enable customers to develop AI locally on the systems they already trust. Position includes owning a summer project: a "hero demo" showcasing an end-to-end GPU-accelerated workflow; Pitch the demo concept directly, driving ownership of the idea from the start; A follow-on project may be assigned if the hero demo is completed early and to a high standard.
 What you'll be doing: 
 Building AI and agentic AI workflows end to end on NVIDIA platforms, including hardware bring-up and troubleshooting
 Creating technical marketing assets such as product demonstrations, videos, playbooks, and one-pagers
 Translating enterprise platform capabilities into real-world use cases across manufacturing, architecture and construction, and media and entertainment
 Defining and testing demos alongside original equipment manufacturer (OEM) partners and internal teams, and organizing a shared demo library
 Owning a summer "hero demo" project: an end-to-end GPU-accelerated workflow that you pitch and then build
 What we need to see: 
 Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (graduating December 2027 or later)
 Programming experience in Python
 Working knowledge of Linux and Windows, including command-line tooling and system configuration
 Hands-on experience with an AI or machine learning framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face
 Experience documenting a technical workflow and presenting it to a technical audience
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or NVIDIA NIM
 Familiarity with CUDA, GPU acceleration concepts, or NVIDIA developer software development kits such as TensorRT, RAPIDS, or Omniverse
 Working knowledge of containers and environment management (Docker, Conda, WSL), Git, and C/C++ or shell scripting

listings.title: Advanced DV Engineer Intern
listings.desc:
Advanced DV Engineering Intern
 About the role
 Astera Labs is seeking an Advanced Design Verification Engineering Intern to help validate complex ASIC and system designs before silicon is available. You will work with design verification engineers to develop tests, improve verification environments, analyze coverage, debug failures, and apply simulation and formal methods to assess whether designs meet their specifications.
 This internship is intended for a student who is ready to go beyond running existing tests and contribute to verification strategy, reusable infrastructure, and difficult debug problems. You will own a scoped project with guidance from experienced engineers and deliver verification work in a usable state.
 What you will do
 Translate architectural, microarchitectural, interface, and product requirements into verification scenarios, test plans, coverage goals, and checkers.
 Develop and maintain SystemVerilog and UVM testbench components, sequences, tests, monitors, scoreboards, functional coverage, and end-of-test checks.
 Add directed, constrained-random, error-injection, compliance, stress, and corner-case tests for blocks, subsystems, or top-level functionality.
 Configure and run simulations and regressions using project submission flows, manifests, plusargs, firmware images, and test definitions.
 Debug failures by correlating logs, UVM messages, assertions, register reports, firmware output, and Verdi or DVE waveforms.
 Triage regression failures, distinguish design issues from testbench or environment issues, reproduce failures, and communicate actionable root-cause analysis.
 Analyze functional and code coverage, identify untested scenarios or coverage gaps, and propose targeted tests or verification improvements.
 Write, review, and debug SystemVerilog assertions and coverage properties that capture design intent and interface behavior.
 Support formal verification flows such as design compile, reset analysis, automatic property extraction, dead-code analysis, and formal property verification.
 Create or improve Python, Tcl, or other automation that simplifies test generation, regression execution, result parsing, coverage analysis, or failure triage.
 Collaborate with RTL design, firmware, emulation, physical design, and systems engineers to clarify assumptions and close verification issues.
 Document test intent, debug findings, coverage status, known limitations, and handoff information; present the completed project and recommendations.
 What you bring
 Enrollment in a bachelor’s, master’s, or Ph.D. program in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
 Coursework, research, or project experience in digital logic, computer architecture, ASIC/FPGA design, verification, embedded systems, or hardware/software integration.
 Programming or verification experience with SystemVerilog, Verilog, C, C++, Python, or a comparable language.
 Familiarity with digital design concepts, simulation, testbenches, interfaces, clocks, resets, registers, and debugging from waveforms or logs.
 Familiarity with Linux development environments, Git, command-line tools, and technical documentation.
 Ability to reason from a specification, investigate failures systematically, and communicate clear technical conclusions.
 Strong ownership, curiosity, practical judgment, and willingness to collaborate across engineering functions.
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience with UVM components, sequences, virtual sequences, agents, monitors, scoreboards, reference models, or functional coverage.
 Familiarity with SystemVerilog Assertions, constrained-random testing, coverage-driven verification, error injection, or compliance testing.
 Exposure to verification IP and protocols such as PCIe, CXL, AXI, or other high-speed and control interfaces.
 Experience with Verdi, DVE, VCS, Questa, Xcelium, VC Formal, or comparable simulation and formal tools.
 Familiarity with formal concepts such as assumptions, assertions, covers, counterexamples, reset analysis, dead-code analysis, or automatic property extraction.
 Experience managing regressions, parsing results, debugging intermittent failures, or running jobs on a compute cluster or CI system.
 Internship experience and compensation
 This is a paid, hourly U.S. internship. The applicable hourly rate is determined as part of the offer process and specified in the offer letter, depending on education level ranges from $35/hour to $55/hour. U.S. interns currently receive a $500-per-week housing/relocation stipend for the duration of the internship. Interns participate in Early Career programming, including technical and professional-development sessions, community events, and an end-of-program project presentation.
 Equal opportunity
 Astera Labs is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage anyone with relevant experience to apply.

listings.desc:
Design Verification Engineer – Intern
 Role overview
 Astera Labs is seeking a motivated Digital Design Verification Intern to join our San Jose design team. This internship offers hands-on experience in functional verification of high-performance connectivity and networking ASICs.
 You will work with experienced design and verification engineers to understand design specifications, develop and execute verification tests, debug simulation failures, and help assess the functionality and reliability of complex digital designs. You will collaborate with RTL design, architecture, and other engineering teams throughout the ASIC development process.
